## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or operational limitation? Please describe.
*Example: "I am always frustrated when trying to debug complex multi-step browser flows without step-level DOM diffing..."*

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Explain how this feature enhances agent reliability, safety, or operability.

## User Persona & Use Cases
- Who will use this feature? (e.g., SRE Operator, Compliance Officer, Agent Developer)
- How does it fit into the Operations Center or API workflow?

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional Context
Add any architectural diagrams, API payload mocks, or UI wireframes.
